description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for POST api/ChannelListing/ClearOneVariation. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Provides the POST clear one variation operation in published product creation and optimization. Use when: Use it when a client needs to run the clear one variation operation for published product creation and optimization. Input: rq: ClearVariationsRequest. Main fields: ChannelListingId: int. Header channel: current ChannelOAuthId. Output: Returns the result or applies the effect of the clear one variation operation. Search terms: channellisting clearonevariation. Send the exact request payload in body. Requires confirmed=true and impactConfirmed=true before execution. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.

confirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly requested or confirmed the exact action.

impactConfirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly confirmed the concrete high-impact consequences.
